title: Easy Banana Pudding Cake Recipe
description: This easy banana pudding cake recipe is made with cake mix and poked with holes and filled with banana pudding for an easy, creamy delicious dessert.
ingredients: 2 (3.5 ounce) packages instant banana pudding mix
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping (such as Cool Whip®), thawed

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Coat a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
Combine cake mix, water, eggs, and oil in a bowl until just moistened; pour batter into the prepared baking dish.

Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean, 34 to 38 minutes. Cool cake in the baking dish for 2 to 3 minutes. Poke several holes into the cake, using the handle of a wooden spoon, being sure to poke through to bottom of cake.

Combine milk and pudding mix in a separate bowl until smooth; rest until begins to thicken slightly, but pudding not fully set, about 2 minutes. Pour pudding over cake; spread evenly, making sure to fill each hole completely. Chill in the refrigerator until cake cooled and pudding set, about 2 hours.
Spread whipped topping over cake; sprinkle with crushed vanilla wafers just before serving.

video.description: Get ready to make a lot of people happy with this super creamy pudding cake that’s so easy to make and even easier to make disappear. Begin by mixing a yellow cake mix with water, eggs and oil, then baking. Mix milk with banana pudding. When the cake has cooled slightly, poke large holes throughout and pour over the pudding. After the cake has chilled and set, cover with clouds of whipped topping and crushed vanilla wafers. Then grab big spoons and dig in!
